subject: Acera: request for custom packaging & multi-year discount exception
messages:
From: Sam Hart <sam.hart@acera.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acera.com
Date: 2026-10-28T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Redwood pilot — pricing/packaging question
Attachments: Acera_SOW_Draft_v3.pdf, Acera_Procurement_Terms.xlsx

Hi Ben —

Appreciate the demo last week. Acera is preparing a three-year commitment for a hybrid deployment: Dedicated reserved capacity for our public workloads plus a Private VPC instance for regulated data. Procurement is pushing hard for a multi-year commercial that includes significant upfront discounts and a packaging credit to cover the on-prem kit.

High level ask: 40% off standard list on year 1, step-down to 30% and 20% in years 2–3, plus a one-time packaging credit (we estimate ~$45k) and net-60 payment terms. We can provide an initial SOW (attached) and would like Redwood VP/CFO sign-off on any exception.

Can you confirm whether this is something you can escalate? Procurement (procurement@acera.com) will expect a paper trail.

—Sam
Sam Hart
Head of Infrastructure Programs
Acera Systems
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sam Hart <sam.hart@acera.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-28T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RE: Redwood pilot — pricing/packaging question
Attachments: redwood_exception_memo_draft.docx

Sam — thanks for the clear write-up and for sending the SOW. I’ll start the internal approval path now and loop in finance and sales leadership (cc'd).

Short answer: 40% top-line is outside our standard discount bands for this packaging; we can escalate an exception but will need documented business justification and terms to protect unit economics (minimum ACV, payment cadence, committed capacity).

I’ve attached a short exception memo I’ll submit to VP/CFO for sign-off — will tailor it with the final SOW details. Expect an internal response within 3 business days; I’ll keep you posted.

Can you confirm target go-live date and if Acera can do 60–80% upfront payment? That materially changes approval thresholds.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Acera pricing exception request (ACR-2026-095)
Attachments: Acera_SOW_Draft_v3.pdf, Acera_Procurement_Terms.xlsx, redwood_exception_memo_draft.docx

Team —

Requesting expedited sign-off on a pricing/packaging exception for Acera Systems. Summary:
- Opportunity: 3-year commitment, hybrid deployment (Dedicated + Private VPC). Estimated list ACV: $1.1M/year.
- Customer ask: 40% off Y1, 30% Y2, 20% Y3; one-time packaging credit ~$45k; net-60 payment; SOW attached.
- Strategic rationale: large strategic brand in our target vertical, reference potential, expansion runway (embedded AI across product lines).
- Risks: high initial discount increases payback time; private deployment increases on-prem support cost and one-off engineering involvement; procurement insists on extended payment terms.

Recommended conditional exception to present to Finance/CFO:
1) Approve up to 32% discount Y1 (to be weighted by committed upfront payment >=60%).
2) Step-down: 24% Y2, 16% Y3 (or equivalent blended cap).
3) Packaging credit capped at $45k conditional on signed SOW and cover of on-prem logistics cost recovery clause.
4) Require 60% upfront payment on execution, remainder net-30 for balance; if net-60 is required, escalate to CFO for additional credit terms.

Please review and advise sign-off path. If approved by finance, I’ll send a formal LOI with these terms and push for signature.

Thanks — Ben
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-30T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Internal: Acera pricing exception request (ACR-2026-095)

Ben — I reviewed the numbers and risk profile. Quick analysis below: 

Financial impact (simple view):
- 1.1M list ACV * 0.32 discount => ~$352k revenue reduction in Y1 (vs list).
- Packaging credit $45k one-time hit at time of deployment.
- With 60% upfront, cash burn on discount is mitigated and payback remains within ~9–12 months.

Recommended approval with conditions:
- Approve up to 32% Y1 (as you proposed) if Acera commits to 60% upfront and a non-cancellable minimum of 18 months of committed capacity (to protect reserved GPU allocation).
- Approve year 2/3 caps at 24% / 16% respectively, but require a blended minimum revenue guarantee across the term if Acera reduces usage.
- Require procurement to accept an escalation clause for packaging cost overruns (Redwood reserves right to invoice actual third-party logistics costs).
- Require legal to add CLIN for on-prem support hours and a termination charge for early exit within first 12 months.

If everyone agrees, this should be routed to CFO for final sign-off because the initial Y1 discount and packaging credit together exceed our delegated approval.

Granting note: I can prepare the formal exception memo for CFO signature once Vivek confirms sales position on discount cap.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Head of Finance, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-01T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Internal: Acera pricing exception request (ACR-2026-095)

Team —
I reviewed the commercial importance: Acera is strategic; getting them as a committed customer accelerates our presence in their sector and opens marketplace/channel references. I support moving faster on this with a firm set of conditions.

My recommendation: Approve a final offer to present to Acera:
- Year 1: 32% off list if Acera signs with 70% upfront payment (this is the lever to defend margin).
- Year 2/3: 24% / 16% with an annual usage floor equal to 75% of year 1 committed capacity; otherwise, true-up to the floor price.
- Packaging credit: up to $45k, but Redwood invoices actual logistics/installation costs exceeding $25k to the customer.
- Payment: prefer 70% upfront, remainder net-30; if customer insists on net-60, CFO approval required and will need a credit holdback.

If CFO signs off, I want Ben to get LOI out within 24 hours. This is time-sensitive — procurement asked for a decision by the end of next week.

—Vivek
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sam Hart <sam.hart@acera.com>, procurement@acera.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-02T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Acera — interim commercial position pending CFO sign-off (ACR-2026-095)
Attachments: none

Sam / procurement team —

Thanks for patience while we routed internally. Preliminary, conditional commercial position Redwood can present:
- Year 1: 32% off list contingent on 70% upfront payment at contract signing.
- Year 2: 24% off list; Year 3: 16% off list, subject to usage floors and true-up clauses.
- Packaging credit: up to $45k; customer responsible for logistics/installation in excess of $25k.
- If Acera requires net-60, we will need CFO approval; otherwise standard payment will be 70% upfront / remainder net-30.

We are submitting a formal exception memo to our CFO today requesting final sign-off. If signed, I’ll send a short LOI with these terms and a requested signature window of 72 hours to hold pricing. If you can confirm 70% upfront today, I can push for accelerated sign-off.

Look forward to hearing —
Ben
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
